description: Scan one website for AI discoverability: which AI crawlers robots.txt allows or blocks (OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot...), llms.txt, sitemap, schema.org data, meta tags and Content Signals. Returns a 0-100 score, grade and prioritized fixes. Fetches only the domain's /robots.txt, /llms.txt, /sitemap.xml and homepage.
name: check_ai_readiness
title: Check AI readiness
